content.text: I'll use pyautogui to navigate Chrome to the font settings and change the size to the largest option.

input.command:
DISPLAY=:0 python3 << 'EOF'
import pyautogui
import time

# Click on the Chrome address bar
pyautogui.click(900, 90)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Select all and clear
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'a')
time.sleep(0.2)

# Type the settings URL
pyautogui.typewrite('chrome://settings/appearance', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(2)
print("Navigated to settings")
EOF

import pyautogui
